title_original: 국선변호정책심의위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Meetings of the Committee)
(1) The Chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee and preside over them.
(2) Meetings shall be classified as regular and extraordinary meetings, to be held as follows:
1. Regular meetings: Once each year;
2. Extraordinary meetings: Whenever the Chairperson deems necessary.
(3) Meetings shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the members incumbent, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative votes of a majority of those present.
(4) Matters of a minor or urgent nature may be resolved in writing by decision of the Chairperson.
(5) The proceedings and contents of Committee meetings shall not be disclosed: Provided, That the Committee may resolve to disclose all or part of meeting materials or proceedings.
(6) The secretary shall prepare minutes recording the gist of resolutions; in the case of a resolution in writing under paragraph (4), a record of the resolution shall be prepared. The Chairperson and secretary shall affix their names and seals or signatures to the minutes or record.
